title: LuckyBreak
description: Random surprises when breaking blocks — fully configurable Paper plugin
body:
Random surprises when breaking blocks — fully configurable Paper plugin

LuckyBreak adds a configurable chance for special events to occur whenever a player breaks a block.
Each block type can have its own probability, creating a dynamic and customizable mining experience.

Designed for survival servers, LuckyBreak rewards exploration and mining with fun, safe, and balanced surprises — without damaging terrain or affecting gameplay stability.

✨ Features

Per-block configurable trigger chances (stone, dirt, ores, etc.)

Multiple fun events:

Diamond or food drops

Chicken spawn

Temporary speed boost

Visual lightning

Safe visual explosion (no block damage)

Flower generation

Fully configurable YAML

Per-player global cooldown

Permission-based event access

Extensive exclusions (blocks, tools, enchantments, gamemodes)

Paper-optimized (1.21–1.21.4)

Safe for survival servers

Zero terrain damage
